requiredClaims.description: Windows 10 22H2 x64 installs, upgrades, uninstalls, and preserves user data
Current stable Windows 11 x64 completes the full signed-build smoke test
100% DPI selection, OCR overlay, pin, and recording coordinates are correct
125% DPI selection, OCR overlay, pin, and recording coordinates are correct
150% DPI selection, OCR overlay, pin, and recording coordinates are correct
200% DPI selection, OCR overlay, pin, and recording coordinates are correct
Mixed-DPI displays with a negative-coordinate monitor pass capture, pin, and recording tests
Selection hook, shortcuts, tray, and windows recover after sleep, wake, and lock
RDP launch and display changes work, and unavailable capture reports an actionable error
NSIS uses the expected data root and only offers the supported update channel
Default NSIS makes zero update-domain requests in the first 2 minutes and across a 24h clock advance until auto-check is enabled
With auto-check off, the settings-page manual check performs exactly one request and arms no timer
System loopback and microphone tracks are audible in the exported file for all four on/off combinations
A blocked or slow write pauses at 32 MiB / 5 s, seals the confirmed part, and the result stays playable
After an Explorer restart and a sleep/wake cycle the tray has exactly one working icon and shortcuts still fire
Portable uses the expected data root and never invokes the NSIS updater
